title: Listening Drill — Mixing paste
description: Practical demonstration. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Mixing paste
sections.transcript:
INSTRUCTOR: This demonstration is about mixing paste for paper craft. Watch the whole process once before trying it yourself. If you start while I'm still talking, you may miss the order of the steps.

INSTRUCTOR: Get the dry ingredients ready. Begin by checking the mixing bowl. When everything is in position, wait ten minutes. It may look as though nothing is happening at first.

INSTRUCTOR: Look for a smooth surface before moving on. wipe up spills immediately. Leave yourself time to clear the work area so the next group can start promptly.
